title: Space sandbox
author: LqqnY
selftext:
I've been working on this project for couple months now. It's written in C# using Godot. The gameplay will be a combination of No Man's Sky and technic Minecraft. The story of the game is going to be similar to Project Hail Mary.



# What's been implemented so far



* Procedurally generated universe with 32 galaxies each having 4000 stars total of 128k stars. tested up to 8m stars with no performance issues.
* Four galaxy types: spiral, elliptical, lenticular, and irregular.
* Procedural star system generation using the in-house accrete simulator.
* 2D system map with pan, zoom, orbit display, planet/moon information, and landing buttons.
* Keplerian orbital mechanics with eccentric and inclined orbits.
* Planet and moon orbital animation.
* Binary-star display and basic circumbinary-system support.
* Asteroid belts and gas-giant rings rendered with deterministic placement.
* Custom toroidal (donut shaped) voxel terrain engine and curved planet surface shader (to fake a spherical surface).
* Multithreaded chunk generation and meshing.
* Geological provinces and rock strata.
* Ore deposits.
* Procedural solar and lunar eclipses.
* Black holes and nebulae.
* Atmosphere.

# To be implemented

* Inventory, quests, trading, alien life and everything else you can expect from a survival sandbox game
* Tech progression from stone tools to space-age technology.
* Expandable space ships.
* Atmosphere.
* Neutron stars, cosmic dust, etc.
* General relativity (maybe).
